content.title: Final Farewell | Silent Exit and Relational Residue
content.summary: Two geologists separate through map memories and one abandoned compass. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing every source-specific surface.

quick_start.input_format: The same two adults anchor present and memory. + A recurring object bridges the time layers. + The emotional change is visible before departure. + One placed object proves the separation. + The final empty route preserves the aftermath instead of reconciliation.
quick_start.recommended_input: Place one adult geologist beneath a transparent hood outside a storm-lit station. Return to the station as her controlled expression breaks and rain runs over the hood. End with the partner at an empty platform as a freight train passes and the compass remains behind.
required_anchors: The same two adults anchor present and memory.
A recurring object bridges the time layers.
One placed object proves the separation.
The final empty route preserves the aftermath instead of reconciliation.
usage_steps: Replace the example subject, setting, and surface details with an original concept.
Keep every required anchor and Creative DNA invariant causally visible.
Choose the MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 prompt and fill only the declared variable slots.
Check duration, event order, camera continuity, sound, and anti-copy constraints before generation.
applicable_scope: Two geologists separate through map memories and one abandoned compass. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing every source-specific surface.
Original 4–15 second concepts that can preserve every required anchor.
MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 projects that need a reusable causal video structure.
not_suitable_for: Requests that copy the source identity, setting, props, dialogue, or shot order.
Concepts that cannot show all required anchors inside the target duration.
Long-form exposition or unrelated multi-location stories without a compact causal chain.
